title: Remove Engram's non-agreed blockers from EO credit: remote exit-code, focused-mode, clock-ahead and unadmitted-change barriers
outcome: Remove Engram's non-agreed blockers from EO credit: remote exit-code, focused-mode, clock-ahead and unadmitted-change barriers
acceptance: A remote completion whose outcome is passed and whose source_id before == after is credited without requiring exit == Some(0) (control.rs ~73-80); a failed outcome still fails
A remote focused run of the declared check is credited like a full run; the not_full_mode refusal (control.rs ~51-52) no longer withholds EO credit
A remote finish time ahead of the receiving host's clock no longer refuses credit (control.rs ~54-62); finished_at presence stays as record shape
The unadmitted-change ordering barrier (feeds.rs ~950-997) no longer withholds credit from a check whose source_id before == after on the bound item
Agreed conditions are unchanged: passed outcome, source_id equality, item/claim/root/run binding, newer-failed-evidence selection, obligations at completion

completion.summary: Delivered the agreed EO changes in the reviewed and fully gated combined landing; installed on Central and DL560.
